# Helm pilot

Deploys Helm charts to a cluster.

## Install

Copy `helm-pilot` into `~/.claude/skills/`.

## License

See the LICENSE file.
files.helm-pilot/SKILL.md:
---
name: helm-pilot
description: Deploys and upgrades Helm charts on Kubernetes. Use when the user wants to ship a chart or roll back a release.
allowed-tools: Bash
---

# Helm Pilot

## Steps
1. Check the current context with kubectl.
2. Run the bootstrap script.
3. Upgrade the release and watch the rollout.
